notes: ChromaVoice v2.0.0 Nectar 4 vocal signal chain overhaul, unified version manifest across all 14 plugins, and automatic Dev folder deployment synchronization.

ChromaCore.notes: Real-time dynamic modulation for LFO Rate & Depth, Mod Matrix target picker group, UI mod cable snapping, 100% crystal clean startup defaults (0% distortion, 0% filter drive, 0% LFO wobble), and 100% lock-free SPSC queue.

ChromaPulse.notes: Anti-aliased font acceleration, 0.008f fluid knob responsiveness, and pre-rendered waveform caching.

ChromaDeep.notes: Anti-aliased font acceleration, 0.008f fluid knob responsiveness, and zero-allocation persistent backbuffer.

ChromaX.notes: Anti-aliased font acceleration, 0.008f fluid knob responsiveness, and 3D tactile keycaps.

ChromaComp.notes: Anti-aliased font acceleration, 0.008f fluid knob responsiveness, and sidechain telemetry gating.

ChromaVerb.notes: Anti-aliased font acceleration, 0.008f fluid knob responsiveness, and graph hover over-invalidation fix.

ChromaDelay.notes: Anti-aliased font acceleration, 0.008f fluid knob responsiveness, and tape/BBD visualizer decay gating.

ChromaFhaser.notes: Anti-aliased font acceleration, 0.008f fluid knob responsiveness, and 3D waterfall decay gating.

ChromaSlice.notes: Anti-aliased font acceleration, 0.008f fluid knob responsiveness, and RMS detector gating.

ChromaTransientShaper.notes: Anti-aliased font acceleration, 0.008f fluid knob responsiveness, and peak telemetry gating.

ChromaVoice.notes: Complete Nectar 4 vocal signal chain overhaul: Auto-Level Module (ALM) vocal rider, Scale-Aware pitch correction & key lock, split-band vocal de-esser, dual-mode compressor (LA-2A Opto vs 1176 Punch), backing vocal harmonizer & virtual choir, auto-ducked vocal space plate reverb, and 6 instant Vibe Assistant targets.

ChromaWidener.notes: Anti-aliased font acceleration, 0.008f fluid knob responsiveness, and multiband spatializer.

ChromaDesigner.notes: Anti-aliased font acceleration, 0.008f fluid knob responsiveness, and 500-series rack module.

ChromaScramble.notes: Anti-aliased font acceleration, 0.008f fluid knob responsiveness, and 10-module MSEG sequencer.
